units.source_text: 我写《雏人偶》已经是几年前的事情了。

en.t: It has already been several years since I wrote Hina Dolls.

units.source_text: 直到现在才写完并不仅仅是因为淹田氏的劝说，

en.t: The reason I have only now finished it is not simply because of Mr. Enda's urging,

units.source_text: 更是因为约莫四五天前，我在住在横滨的某一个英国人家的客厅里，

en.t: but rather because about four or five days ago, in the sitting room of a certain Englishman's house in Yokohama,

units.source_text: 看到一个红发女童将一个陈旧的雏人偶的头当做玩具玩。

en.t: I saw a red-haired little girl playing with the head of an old hina doll as a toy.

units.source_text: 这个故事里的雏人偶，现在可能也和铅制的士兵、橡胶的玩具等等，

en.t: The hina doll in this story too, by now perhaps along with lead soldiers, rubber toys, and the like,

units.source_text: 一起被装进玩具箱里，遭受相似的不幸吧。

en.t: has probably been packed away in a toy box and is suffering a similar misfortune.
